data.content_ref: inline:The direct constructive split (case on presence of zero) and the inclusion-exclusion complement share mechanism as two independent derivations of the same combinatorial identity, and the result reduces to the count 648; refuted if either derivation yields a different residue modulo 9, since both count the same set and must agree numerically, or if the PIE calculation double-counts by mishandling the triple-equality intersection. The intermediate complement must equal 252 for both; refuted if any partition over-subtracts by one due to boundary mishandling of 100.
